quotes.basis: Krisumi Corporation chairman Ashok Kapur, quoted on the launch of the project's new 'Forest Reserve' phase: 'Launching our first project at ₹8,500 per sq. ft. ... Today Krisumi City commands around ₹24,000 per sq. ft.' Figure is stated for 'Krisumi City' overall (the township), not disaggregated by phase in the source; attributed here to Waterside Residences because ₹24,000/sq ft closely matches this project's own portal pricing (₹23,980-24,030/sq ft) as the newest, priciest active phase, whereas the older Waterfall Residences/Suites phases trade lower per current portal data.
quotes.snippet: Launching our first project at ₹8,500 per sq. ft. ... Today Krisumi City commands around ₹24,000 per sq. ft., reflecting strong value creation and market leadership.

quotes.basis: Developer page states '3 & 4 Bed Residences', area range '2277 - 2966 Sq.Ft.', and 'Starting from INR 5.86 Cr.'. Price and area are on the same page but not explicitly paired per unit, so computed as a range: 5.86 Cr / 2966 sq ft (largest area) = ~19,758/sq ft, and 5.86 Cr / 2277 sq ft (smallest area, likely matching the 'starting from' price) = ~25,735/sq ft.
quotes.snippet: 3 & 4 Bed Residences ... 2277 - 2966 Sq.Ft. ... Starting from INR 5.86 Cr.*

sector_news.headline: Buying property in Gurugram to get costlier as circle rates hiked by up to 75%
sector_news.figure: Government collector/circle rate (not market price) for Sectors 63, 63A, 64 and 67 (SPR / Golf Course Extension Road corridor) hiked 45%, from Rs 58,500 to Rs 84,825 per square yard (~Rs 6,500 to ~Rs 9,425 per sq ft equivalent, converting 1 sq yd = 9 sq ft)
